propositions: Public Python API surface is manually documented and experiences recurring drift (reuse-surface.md touched ~20+ times per RP-04 slices); existing partial guard (test_reuse_surface_doc.py) hardcodes a curated subset and requires hand edits in lockstep with signature changes.

A portable, pure-stdlib (inspect/importlib) drift gate detects removed/renamed/added public symbols and signature changes by comparing live surface against committed baseline JSON, failing with clear remediation guidance.

The gate runs as a subprocess-executed unit test (immune to test-tier monkeypatching) under 'make test' with no CI-provider or external dependencies (griffe NOT added), mirroring the existing config-key drift gate pattern.

The source-of-truth surface includes the rebar facade (__all__) plus documented reuse subsystems (signing, runner, contracts, findings, prompting.prompts, workflow.executor), capturing signatures and pinned immutable constants.
The hardcoded subset assertions from the deleted test_reuse_surface_doc.py are automatically subsumed by the baseline, proven by test_subsumes_* assertions with no coverage loss.
An intentional surface change is accommodated via 'python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --update' to regenerate the baseline, with tests proving stale baseline fails --check and passes after update.
